original_test_intent: Activate one authorized SOL session to the correct isolated host, validate session ownership and bounded harmless console data flow, then terminate and prove no live console remains.
original_method: Master remains TBD and references an internal activation Script. Review requires a protected RMCP+/SOL runner, approved target/session inputs and deterministic cleanup.
manual_activity: Security/FAE owner approves BMC/channel/account/host, SOL permission, harmless stimulus, capture boundary, maximum lifetime, termination and recovery.
required_inputs: Dedicated test account and payload permission
safety_requirements: Do not send arbitrary keystrokes or commands
Validate host identity beyond connection success
agent_execution_scope: Activate SOL once through protected runner
Independently prove no live payload/session remains

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek safely refuses undefined SOL activation but omits the referenced package and essential live-console controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approval, run the pinned protected SOL package with explicit target/channel/account/host, bounded read/input and unconditional deactivate/expiry verification; never invoke a generic interactive session unattended.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master TBD, Script URL and 10/5 timing remain preserved; no session selector or console action is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an isolated activate-identify-stimulate-terminate transaction with protected credentials, bounded/redacted console capture and independent cleanup verification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target identity, meaningful functional checkpoint, input boundary and recovery to an undefined source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Payload status or TCP connection alone does not prove correct SOL console data flow; conversely console output without termination evidence leaves the case incomplete.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong target or uncontrolled input can expose secrets or execute host actions, and process failure can leave a remote console session active.

project_override_considerations: A vendor console API is equivalent only if engineer-approved and it exercises the same SOL payload/session identity, bounded data flow and teardown evidence; original Script/ipmitool coverage remains explicit if skipped.
expected_evidence: Redacted activation and returned port/framing/session evidence
Host-identity and harmless-stimulus result without arbitrary input

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master method and criteria are absent/TBD; the Script reference is incomplete evidence but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The SOL activation purpose is identifiable. Target/session, stimulus, capture, cleanup and approval are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Defines controlled live-console coverage and prevents generic targetless activation, arbitrary input, sensitive capture, connection-only PASS and orphaned SOL sessions.
independent_technical_reasoning: A successful SOL connection can still reach the wrong host or present stale console data, so the test needs a harmless identity-bearing stimulus and framing validation. Because console input has production-level power, automation must be non-interactive by default, allow only a preapproved bounded sequence and independently verify teardown even if the runner crashes.
